title: Vibrant Valencian Cassaba Jjigae Wrap
description: This Spanish Galician dish features cassaba, roast, and a shojin-friendly twist, served in a corn-husk-wrap. The vibrant flavors and flaky texture make it a show-off dish.
instructions: Peel the cassaba and cut it into 1-inch cubes.
Toss the cassaba with olive oil, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Shred the roast chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the shredded chicken and cook for 2 minutes, until heated through.
Warm the corn husks by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the chicken and cassaba mixture onto the center of each husk, then topping with chopped cilantro.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
